nucleosomal DNA, which is refractory to recombination signal sequence (RSS)-mediated V(D)J DNA cleavage, becomes accessible for V(D)J recombinase activity upon binding of HMG1.

nucleosomal DNA can be refractory to VDJ cleavage, but the presence of Hmg1, a chromosomal non-histone DNA-binding protein that is associated with chromatin, stimulates VDJ cleavage of nucleosome templates.
